title: Your watch counts to 32,768 every second

captions.text: !32,768 vibrations! make *one second* on your watch.
captions.say: Thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-eight vibrations make one second on your watch.

captions.text: Inside is a tiny sliver of *quartz.*
Put *voltage* on it, and it vibrates

captions.say: thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-eight times a second.

captions.text: That number is *two to the fifteenth.*
A chip *halves* the signal *fifteen times* in a row:

captions.say: sixteen thousand, three hundred eighty-four, eight thousand, one hundred ninety-two, all the way down to one.

captions.text: It's this fast because a slower crystal

captions.say: and thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-eight sits just above
